name: Saudi Ground Services Company
summary: Saudi Ground Services Company provides ground-handling services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers passenger services, such as station management, gate services, VIP services, deportee handling, additional security services, flight operations, and assisting passengers with reduced mobility, as well as arrival and transfer services, check-in services, excess baggage services, boarding pass and baggage tagging, load control, crew handling, and passenger manifests and seat allocation. It also provides loading and unloading, baggage assembly, sorting, reconciliation and transportation, and operation and handling of baggage reconciliation system; traffic control services; and ramp…
